about: Authored parameter schema for procedural retro SFX, in the sfxr/jsfxr lineage. jsfxr's engine is reported as UNLICENSE (public-domain dedication); NO jsfxr code is staged here — only this parameter shape, so the Step 4 agent can author the lane's own original sounds with any compatible tool and export WAV/OGG. Generated sounds are the lane's own sounds; no commercial sound is copied.

parameters.freq_slide: frequency change over the sound's life (negative = falling pitch, e.g. impacts)
parameters.noise_burst_s: noise component length for hits/explosions, 0 = pure tone

lane_presets_to_author.impact_light: short square blip, fast falling pitch, decay < 0.1 s
lane_presets_to_author.impact_heavy: noise burst + falling sine, decay 0.2-0.3 s
lane_presets_to_author.ring_close: rising sine sweep, the ring-capture close cue (Step 7)

rules: Every preset is stored as parameters + exported audio, never as a recording of another game's sound.
Impact presets fire on the battle timeline contact event (step1/step2), not on the damage-number event.
Reduced-motion / muted settings silence SFX without stopping the timeline (see step6 gate).

wiring_target.target_module: SFX preset library + Howler playback layer (see howler-tool-note)
